scientific_integrity: Universal theorem proved analytically. Exact rational and finite-difference checks are supporting diagnostics, not an exhaustive proof. The originality assessment recognizes inaccessible related full text and possible unindexed equivalences. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is local and projective, applies only to strictly positive finite matrices and positive marginals, and does not guarantee convergence from arbitrary BDRS starts, rounding stability, or an explicit basin radius. A plausible related 2026 arXiv manuscript was accessible only by abstract.
title: Universal local attraction and the square-root Sinkhorn rate for Bregman Douglas–Rachford matrix scaling
